title: Basic Checkmate Patterns: King & Queen vs King
summary: Team up your king and queen to trap a lone king.

steps.text: Let's learn a basic checkmate pattern: KING and QUEEN versus a lone KING. The queen and king work together to trap the enemy king against the edge of the board, then deliver checkmate!
Notice how the White king on c7 supports the queen — without the king's help, the queen alone often can't checkmate! Keep your king close by as you close in.

steps.prompt: Slide your queen all the way across to deliver checkmate!
steps.successText: Checkmate! King and queen teamwork wins the game.
steps.retryText: Your king already covers b8 and b7 — slide the queen onto the a-file to finish the job.

steps.prompt: Same idea, mirrored! Slide the queen across to checkmate the king in the corner.
steps.successText: Another checkmate — you've mastered the pattern!
steps.retryText: Your king already covers g8 and g7 — slide the queen onto the h-file to finish the job.

steps.text: Great work! You've learned the basics of king and queen checkmates. Keep practicing, and you'll be spotting checkmates everywhere. You've completed the beginner chess course — congratulations, future champion!
